objective: maximize cumulative user profit while enforcing verified-publication floors, minimizing intervention, and amplifying only evidence-backed winners

winnerAmplification.evidence: Current repository metrics still contain no BOOTH sales, no note sales/PV/likes, no Microsoft Store funnel metrics and no GitHub Pages conversion metrics.
winnerAmplification.decision: Do not spend production capacity on speculative derivative families merely because source products are public. Preserve coherent low-build-cost bundle hypotheses, but activate only after observed demand appears.
winnerAmplification.activationRule: A theme becomes amplification-eligible after a clear relative quantitative signal or multiple independent qualitative demand signals. Publication alone is insufficient.

cvLtvPolicy.reason: No product-level conversion or sales baseline exists; speculative repricing would reduce learning quality.
cvLtvPolicy.notePricingNextTest: Use future high-intent practical know-how articles to test roughly 1,480-1,980 JPY when the promised outcome and reusable value justify it; retain lower-priced entry products and do not bulk-reprice existing articles yet.
cvLtvPolicy.boothAovNextTest: Prepare coherent bundles only after a credible demand signal; keep standalone products unchanged and independently purchasable.
cvLtvPolicy.storeNextTest: No product-page experiment before the CSV Cleaner listing is live and baseline traffic exists. After publication, preserve the initial certified listing as control and add source-specific campaign IDs to external links.

measurementPriority.MicrosoftStore: Complete CSV Cleaner identity/submission first, persist the verified Store URL, then collect page views, acquisitions, installs, conversion, campaign/source data and health metrics before visual experiments or derivatives.
measurementPriority.note: Capture article PV, paid sales and likes on comparable exposure windows; use revenue per view rather than raw sale count alone when pricing evidence becomes available.
measurementPriority.BOOTH: Capture product-level orders/sales and any available traffic/favorite data; do not infer demand from buyer-visible status.
measurementPriority.GitHubPages: Capture tool traffic and outbound clicks; use a distinct Microsoft campaign ID per external source once a Store destination exists.

verifiedExamples: thesis-weekly-plan -> verified BOOTH thesis progress OS
interview-star-builder -> verified BOOTH AI job-hunt consistency OS
crossSellPolicy.rule: One context-matched CTA after the free core workflow is preferred. Do not add unrelated or multiple competing CTAs without click/conversion evidence.

productionPriority: Recover paid publication debt with qualified distinct products during available PC windows.
Complete Microsoft Store CSV Cleaner identity/submission prerequisites and measurement plumbing.
For future high-intent note practical articles, test a higher price band without altering existing prices until exposure/sales data exist.
Preserve conditional low-cost BOOTH bundle candidates; activate only after observed demand.
When observed performance arrives, move the strongest differentiated derivative or monetization change to the front of product_backlog immediately.
antiSpamRules: No cosmetic app clones or name-only variants.
Every derivative must solve a meaningfully different job, audience, format or advanced workflow.
Do not cannibalize a winning single product with a cheaper bundle; bundles must add value and maintain sensible price architecture.
Do not infer sales, PV, conversion, acquisitions, installs or retention.
Do not change multiple customer-facing variables before a measurable baseline exists.
